verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has documented glTF import support (dedicated importer docs) and lists OBJ, STL, .babylon, and other formats, plus exporters for Blender/Maya/3ds Max, and community testimony confirms Blender model data "just works." However, FBX and USD import are not evidenced anywhere in the pack — only glTF is deeply documented, and the format list explicitly omits FBX/USD. missing for 10: documented FBX import support, documented USD import support, independent hands-on verification of clean cross-format fidelity (e.g., materials/animations surviving import) beyond glTF.
